posts.author: Brimball
posts.text: Pareto analyse av KMAR. Dette er ingen kjøpsanbefaling. 14.09.2026  Potentially a big order quarter ahead open_in_new We are 2% below consensus EBITDA for Q3’26e, but expect orders to steal the show. Five large offshore/naval awards announced so far support our estimate of 1.24x BTB, up from 1.11x in H1’26. Near-term estimate risk also looks limited, as H2 consensus assumes no material aftermarket recovery. Meanwhile, underlying markets are booming, with yard orders up 36% YTD and offshore and LNG activity remaining strong. Timing an aftermarket rebound is difficult, but it will eventually come, while 20% consensus downgrades YTD have bought time. We see an attractive setup into 2027, with strong newbuild momentum, eventual aftermarket normalization and cost savings driving accelerating earnings growth. BUY, TP NOK 77 reiterated
